text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, it's finally the 
Classic Year. I'll keep looking straight 
ahead and do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight, who had been holding back in 
training until now. You can clearly feel 
her fierce determination to make this year 
the one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that in a few months, a 
physical examination would be conducted to 
determine her future course.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together!
Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And of course, North Flight wasn't the 
only one who was fired up—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year to ya! Hehe, sorry for 
droppin' by like this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, Yukino-chan. 
Well then, shall we get going right away?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—To find a stylish look worthy of the 
Classic Year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to work harder on fashion during 
my Classic year"... It was before the new 
year that Yukino Bijin came to me with 
that request.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, North Flight suggested that 
they might as well go pick out clothes 
now, during the New Year's sales.
choice_data_list:
Are you really sure it's okay for me to 
come along too?

Are you sure it's okay for me to come 
along too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since you're Flight-san's Trainer, I bet 
you've got a super cool perspective on 
things too...!
choice_data_list: I-I wonder...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we'll have to live up to 
Yukino-chan's expectations♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well now, well now, let's get right down 
to putting together an outfit!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
After asking Yukino-chan beforehand, I 
went ahead and decided on a few themes 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, that really helps! 'Cause I don't 
know nothin' about this stuff...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Every single one will look great on you, 
Yukino-chan! Choose with confidence♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First up is the "Early Spring Breezy 
Coord"! With bright colors and sheer 
accents, let's get a head start on spring!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the "Comfort-First Chill 
Outfit"! With its soft texture and cozy 
length, you can be yourself anytime, 
anywhere♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, the 'Clever & Slightly 
Adventurous Outfit'! This one's a special 
surprise coord, so details are top 
secret!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawawa~! They all sound so stylish, han...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...U-Um! What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What kinda style d'ya think suits me!?
choice_data_list: Is it okay for me to decide?
Is it okay for me to decide?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my head feels like it's going to 
explode...! I'd really appreciate it if 
you could decide for me~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san, which one do you 
think suits Yukino-chan best?
choice_data_list: A light outfit getting a jump on spring
A laid-back coord focused on comfort
Skillful Little Adventure Coord

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has a wintry image, but 
seeing her bright, beaming smile made me 
think a gorgeous spring vibe would suit 
her just as well.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, nice choice!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with a more vibrant pink than 
what Yukino-chan is wearing now... and 
layer some organza over the bottoms!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-Organza? Layer it on...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll explain as we go. Let the shopping 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, Trainer-san! Thank ya kindly 
for keepin' me company, yes indeedy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's charm lies in the 
comforting warmth she brings, after all. I 
wanted to propose an outfit that makes the 
best use of that quality.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, nice choice!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this ankle-length quilted skirt 
the centerpiece, keeping an eye on the 
silhouette so it doesn't look too puffy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"E-Expansion!? Eek... that's 
terrifying..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll explain later! Time to 
start shopping!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, Trainer-san! Thank ya kindly 
for keepin' me company, yes indeedy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin probably wants to challenge 
herself. Taking her feelings into account, 
I boldly chose an unfamiliar outfit for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: E-Eek! Please go easy on me...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Yukino-chan. I won't make 
you take on a challenge that makes your 
heart anxious!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"With heels slightly higher than usual, or 
earrings... simple accessories like that 
can elevate your mood from within♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's do this right. Time to 
start shopping!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, Trainer-san! Thank ya kindly 
for keepin' me company, yes indeedy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I could picture myself 
shining like a tiara...!
choice_data_list: (The Tiara... huh)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan is aiming for the Triple Tiara 
route, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You bet it is, gansu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a rough road. And I know it 
might be punching above my weight, too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This year we're up against someone crazy 
strong named Harp Alpha... It's an 
exceptionally steep road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha... I've heard rumors about 
her. She's a highly capable Umamusume, 
considered the heavy favorite for this 
year's Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I just can't help longing for the 
tiara, for that sparkle."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, you're relying on the power of 
fashion?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to the two of you, courage 
came welling up whooosh inside me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure I can... b-become an Umamusume 
worthy of a tiara too!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all! Classic races only 
happen once in a lifetime... I want to 
seize this chance to shine bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Parting ways with Yukino Bijin, who had 
other errands to run... North Flight 
invited me to take a slight detour on our 
way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Classic races really are something 
special, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The girls aiming for that stage... 
somehow, they shine so brightly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san was the same way. She followed 
the Classic Triple Crown route...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Watching them compete with their friends 
to better themselves... It was so 
mesmerizingly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were to enter, would it be the 
Tiara route?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho seems tough in terms of 
distance... In that case, the Tiara route 
with its mile races would be better.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks might be a bit tough, but the 
2000m Shuka Sho could work... If I were to 
put together an outfit—"
choice_data_list: Outfit?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"My best coordination is already set, 
but... I feel like running at medium 
distances would call for a completely 
different outfit."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... what kind of me that would 
be... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan was shining so brightly that 
it made me want to think about my own 
future too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My imagination just ran wild with the 
outfit ideas, that's all♪ Please don't 
mind me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, step by step... That's how North 
Flight had progressed, and now, for the 
first time, she was voicing her hopes for 
a race beyond the mile.
choice_data_list:
(Should I just write that off as my 
imagination?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
All on my own, it definitely would've been 
tough. It's all thanks to you guiding me, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. By facing the materials 
with love... I truly believe we can seize 
the most brilliant sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was difficult back then. But now... 
with who we are now, we should be able to 
take one more step and think about it.
choice_data_list: （……Alright!）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We might not make the adjustments in time 
for the Oka Sho or the Oaks, but... 
there's still a chance for the Shuka Sho. 
In that case—
choice_data_list:
Let's have the best adventure yet at the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...It's just a wild fantasy, okay? I know 
how difficult it is—"
choice_data_list: You've grown so much lately.
You've grown so much lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take out my notebook and check the 
training records. It may be small steps, 
but looking at the accumulated numbers 
gives me a profound sense of hope.
choice_data_list: Right now, you're brimming with potential.
Right now, you are full of potential.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...Could I be the possibility...?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Can I really wear it? Even someone like 
me... the radiance of the tiara?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall her enjoying all sorts of outfits 
today. To her, who knows such happiness, 
there is only one thing I want to convey.
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy racing just like fashion!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That is... a really wonderful way of 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, I want to enjoy it. —The Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The start of the Classic year... Together 
with North Flight, we set our sights on 
that great goal: the Shuka Sho.
